title: RIL Annual Financial Disclosures FY24
excerpt: Net debt stood at zero on net basis in oil-to-chemicals and telecom businesses. Consolidated revenue reached INR 1,000,122 crore. Capital expenditure was INR 131,769 crore. Promoter shareholding stood at 50.3% with zero shares pledged.

title: TCS Audited Financial Results and Shareholding FY24
excerpt: Operating margin stood at 24.6%. The company is virtually debt-free with cash and cash equivalents of INR 50,460 crore. Promoter holding was steady at 71.77% with zero promoter pledge. Final dividend of INR 28 per share declared.

source: BSE Shareholding and Basel III Disclosures FY24
title: HDFC Bank Annual Financial Statements and Regulatory Disclosures
excerpt: Gross NPA ratio stood at 1.24% with Net NPA at 0.33%. Capital adequacy ratio was 18.80% well above regulatory requirement. Promoter holding is 0% as HDFC Bank is a widely held, board-governed institution. Deposit growth was 26.4% YoY.

source: NSE Form 20-F and Audited Statements FY24
title: Infosys Consolidated Financial Statements FY24
excerpt: Free cash flow for the year was USD 2.9 billion. Company has zero long-term debt. Promoter shareholding stood at 14.6% with no pledged shares. Revenue grew 1.4% in constant currency. Large deal TCV stood at USD 17.7 billion.

title: Tata Motors Annual Report FY24
excerpt: JLR automotive net debt reduced to GBP 732 million. Consolidated revenue grew 26.6% to INR 437,928 crore. Promoter holding is 46.36% with zero pledged shares. Board recommended dividend of INR 6 per ordinary share.

title: Zomato Q4 and Annual Financial Disclosures FY24
excerpt: Consolidated PAT turned positive to INR 351 crore for FY24 compared to a loss of INR 971 crore in FY23. Quick commerce (Blinkit) GOV grew 93% YoY. Net cash balance stood at INR 12,240 crore with zero long-term debt. Institution holding is 54.7%.

company: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
title: IRCTC Annual Disclosures and Promoter Holding FY24
excerpt: IRCTC is zero-debt with cash balance of INR 2,400 crore. Government of India (promoter) holds 62.40% equity with zero pledge. Operating profit margin reached 35.8%. Monopoly catering and ticketing agreement with Ministry of Railways remains intact.

title: ITC Financial Results and Demerger Disclosure FY24
excerpt: Demerger of Hotels business approved by shareholders. Total revenue from operations was INR 70,251 crore. Zero debt with robust cash surplus of INR 19,500 crore. FMCG-others revenue crossed INR 20,000 crore mark.
